The 30th Gawad Urian Awards () is held on September 13, 2007. It honors the best Philippine films of 2006. Dominated mostly by independent films, the ceremony was hosted by Regine Velasquez  and Janno Gibbs held at Henry Lee Irwin Theater of Ateneo de Manila University in Quezon City.
Kubrador dominated the ceremony with 5 awards including Best Picture, Best Director and Best Actress, out of 11 nominations. Established in 1976, the Gawad Urian Awards highlights the best of Philippine cinema as decided by the Filipino Film Critics.
